pages.title: Healing (16 uses)
pages.text: When your health drops below maximum, recover 30 percent of your max health. 5-second cooldown per trigger.

$(bold)Speed Boost (180 uses)$() — while sprinting, refreshes Speed II.$(br)$(bold)Hydrophobic (180 uses)$() — while your air runs low, restores 40 air per tick. A drowning aid.$(br2)$(bold)Lava Affinity (180 uses)$() — when on fire, in lava, or taking fire damage, grants Lava Affinity: faster swimming, clear vision in lava, and fire immunity.

$(bold)Shelter (16 uses)$() — when a single hit would deal at least 20 percent of your current health, the hit is reduced to exactly 20 percent. Your anti-one-shot insurance, with a 5-second cooldown.
